pubs.note: Box Hill to Dorking on foot, the 2:34 to Victoria, then walked into Belgravia. First of the pair.
Two minutes on from the Grenadier. Out via Harrods food hall, home early.
Walked from Maltby St along Bermondsey Wall, past The Angel, into Rotherhithe on the south bank.
One stop from the Mayflower, under the Thames through Brunel's 1843 tunnel to the north bank. Windrush home to CJ.

board.text: Blue Anchor (1722, by Hammersmith Bridge) pairs with The Dove: station, bridge, riverside walk, Dove.
Alternates: Holly Bush on the Heath day (can stand in for the Spaniards); Plume of Feathers (1691) on the Greenwich day, 5 min from the Trafalgar.
Churchill Arms pairing: the tick, then Sunday roast at the Fat Badger or pie at the Pelican, all in a 10-minute Notting Hill walk.
Old Bank of England (Fleet St, 1888 banking hall) is a pending candidate. It slots in by the Cheshire Cheese.
City cluster is a weekday play: Butler's Head, the Jampot, the Mitre and Cittie of Yorke all shut or limited at weekends.
Before any crawl, ask in the thread. Big football nights pack every pub in zones 1-2.
